rule: Change log (al), 22 October 2026. Laws passed on the same day and printed on the same gazette page are ordered as the gazette prints them, read from the issue's table of contents or from a footnote in which one law cites the other's page as an earlier amendment. Where neither shows it, laws amending the same Basic Law follow their published amendment numbers, and laws amending different Basic Laws follow the order of their bills (Bills issue, then page). Laws on the same page passed on different days need no entry: the passage date orders them.
